# BizBooks

> Accounting, invoicing, payroll and tax tracking for registered Nigerian companies (agencies, consultancies, IT and B2B service firms). A dashboard shows cash flow, profit, receivables and payables, and upcoming payroll and tax deadlines. Clients pay through BizBooks Payments (Paystack settles directly to the company's bank; ₦500 flat fee), the company's own Paystack or Flutterwave account, or bank transfer; BizBooks never holds customer money.

## Stay organized & tax-ready
- Dashboard: cash flow, profit and loss (accrual), expense breakdown, net income by year, aged receivables and payables
- Expenses with receipt photos, bills (unpaid supplier invoices) and recurring expenses
- Reports: Profit & Loss (accrual or cash), Cash Flow, VAT, Income by Client, Aged Receivables, Client Deposits, Purchases by Supplier, Aged Payables, Payroll Summary, All Transactions
- Tax calendar for VAT (21st), PAYE (10th), pension (7 working days after pay day) and withholding tax, using the Nigeria Tax Act 2025 rules from 2026

## Get paid
- Invoices with CAC/RC number, TIN, client PO number, 7.5% VAT and 2%/5%/10% WHT, amount in words
- Quotes clients accept online, with optional deposits credited on the final invoice
- Recurring invoices and automatic reminders
- BizBooks Payments: add a verified business bank account (no API keys); clients pay by card, transfer or USSD and Paystack settles straight to that account; ₦500 flat fee per payment
- Or online payments through the company's own Paystack or Flutterwave keys (encrypted)

## Pay your team
- Payroll for staff (PAYE, 8%/10% pension, NHF, rent relief) and contractors (withholding tax)
- Payslips, bank bulk-transfer schedule (CSV), and automatic salary expense entries

## Switching from Wave or Zoho Books
- Import clients, invoices (with line items, VAT and balances), services and recurring invoices from Wave or Zoho Books CSV exports; retainers are detected from invoice history
- 5 invoice styles (Classic, Contemporary, Minimal, Letterhead, Compact), item descriptions and invoice titles
- [BizBooks vs Zoho Books](/compare/zoho-books): BizBooks includes Nigerian payroll (Zoho Payroll isn't available in Nigeria) and built-in Paystack/Flutterwave; Zoho Books offers NRS e-invoicing, inventory and projects
- [BizBooks vs Wave](/compare/wave): Wave no longer sends invoices outside the US and Canada

## Pricing
- 30-day Pro trial for every new business (no card), extendable to 51 days by setting up; 60 days when referred by a BizBooks user. Referral rewards: 3 months of Pro per business that gets going.
- Free: invoicing, payments, expenses, dashboard, tax tracking, payroll for up to 3 people
- Pro: unlimited recurring items, full payroll with emailed payslips, quote deposits, reminders, branding, CSV exports

## Advisors (done-for-you service)
- Outsourced monthly bookkeeping, tax & compliance filings, payroll management, fractional CFO and catch-up bookkeeping by the BizBooks advisory team. Free consultation: /advisors
